title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Blueberry Ice Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Blueberry Ice Nic Salt keeps things simple with a juicy Blueberry flavour supported by a clean, frosty Ice exhale. The Blueberry is sweet with a slight tartness, capturing that familiar berry taste without being too heavy. The Ice adds a brisk, cooling sensation that enhances the freshness without muting the fruit. It’s a reliable, all-day vape for anyone who prefers straightforward fruit profiles with a cooling lift. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is best suited to MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits and pod systems. Choose from 10mg or 20mg nicotine strengths for fast absorption and a smooth, consistent throat hit. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
